sub: Microsoft Teams and Zoom rooms, from huddle spaces to boardrooms. One partner designs, installs and supports it all.
intro_p: It has never been easier to bring participants from multiple locations into a single meeting. We convert any space into a productive video conference room with the right displays, cameras, speakers and microphones, and the devices that seamlessly connect and integrate everything.
tech_p: From a simple presentation room to a fully immersive, fully controlled system, our engineers design around how your people actually meet.

cards.alt: Conference room with a wall display
cards.p: Simple presenting, minimalist all-in-one video soundbars, or highly customized systems that give you complete control.

cards.alt: Video meeting with a camera above the display
cards.p: Purpose-built cameras, microphones and speakers so every participant is clearly seen and heard.

cards.alt: Team sharing content from their own devices
cards.p: Let people connect the laptops and devices they already use instead of learning new, complex systems.

partner_p: One team designs, engineers, installs and supports your meeting spaces. You get one point of contact and one accountable partner, and nothing falls between vendors.
